name: CTS International Logistics Corporation Limited
summary: CTS International Logistics Corporation Limited, a freight forwarding company, provides logistics solutions internationally. It offers international air, sea, and rail integrated freight forwarding business, heavy cargo, project logistics, railway transport, third-party warehousing logistics, cross-border e-commerce logistics, aviation supplies logistics, and customs declaration and inspection services. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
